h1: React Native conversion, from install to active user
overview: Many people open an app once and never return. We look at your first-run flow, upgrade screen and key buttons, then rebuild the weak spots in your app code. That can mean a shorter sign-up, clearer onboarding, better wording on upgrade prompts and event tracking, so you can see where users drop off. We aim for a simpler path, not tricks that push people.

faq: Can you promise more subscribers or active users?
No. Results depend on your product, audience and traffic. We fix clear friction, set up tracking so you can measure the change, and tell you honestly what the numbers show.
Which analytics tool do you use?
Firebase Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude or PostHog, whichever you already have. If you have none, we suggest a free option and set up basic events, billed to you only if the tool charges.
Do you follow store rules for paywalls and ratings?
Yes. Apple and Google have strict rules on upgrade screens, trial wording and rating prompts. We keep prices and renewal terms clear and ask for ratings through the official prompts only.
Do I need analytics in my app already?
No. If your app has none, the Standard and Premium packages add event tracking on the steps that matter. Basic works from a walk-through of the app and your own observations.
